title: Normalize generated summary fingerprints
summary: Make generated-summary fingerprints invariant to LF versus CRLF checkout line endings.
reason: The Windows worktree generated fingerprints from CRLF bytes while GitHub checked out LF content, producing generated-context drift for unchanged logical source text.
behavior_before: Generated-summary SHA-256 values used raw file bytes, so checkout line-ending conversion changed every affected fingerprint.
behavior_after: Generated-summary SHA-256 values canonicalize text line endings before hashing, so equivalent LF and CRLF source content has one stable fingerprint.
manual_validation: RED: test_summary_fingerprint_normalizes_windows_and_unix_line_endings failed because raw LF and CRLF source bytes produced different SHA-256 values.
rollback_plan: Revert the fingerprint canonicalization and regenerated summaries only if a demonstrated non-text source requires byte-level summary hashing; rerun the cross-platform regression and generated-context audit.
